name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid-chest.
Push the bar back up explosively to starting position, keeping your back slightly arched.
start_pos: Lie on bench, arms fully extended holding barbell over chest.
movement: Lower the barbell vertically to touch the sternum.
end_pos: Push the barbell back to the starting point.
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees, holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the weights upward until arms are extended above your chest.
Lower the weights slowly under control back to starting position.
start_pos: Seated on incline bench, dumbbells held at shoulder level.
movement: Press dumbbells upwards vertically.
end_pos: Dumbbells are at peak position, arms extended, then lower them.
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Push-ups
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower your body until your chest almost touches the floor, keeping core tight and back straight.
Push back up to the starting position.
start_pos: Plank position, hands under shoulders, toes on the floor.
movement: Bend elbows to lower chest toward the floor.
end_pos: Push back up until arms are straight.
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above chest, palms facing each other.
Lower weights out to sides in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze chest to return dumbbells to starting position.
start_pos: Flat on bench, dumbbells held above chest, palms facing.
movement: Open arms wide in arc until chest stretches.
end_pos: Bring dumbbells back together over chest.
common_mistakes: Bending elbows too much (making it a press)
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a pulldown station and grip bar wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest while leaning back slightly.
Slowly return the bar to the start position.
start_pos: Seated at lat pulldown machine, arms extended, gripping bar.
movement: Pull bar down toward collarbone, squeezing shoulder blades.
end_pos: Return bar slowly to top.
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: One Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on a flat bench, keeping back flat and parallel to floor.
Hold a dumbbell in opposite hand, arm hanging straight down.
Pull the dumbbell up to your hip, keeping elbow close to side.
Lower weight back to start position.
start_pos: One knee/hand on bench, other arm holding dumbbell down.
movement: Pull dumbbell up to ribcage/hip.
end_pos: Lower dumbbell back to full arm extension.
common_mistakes: Pulling with biceps instead of lat
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, bend forward from hips at 45 degrees.
Grip barbell with overhand grip and pull to upper abdomen.
Slowly lower back to start.
start_pos: Hip-hinged stance, holding barbell hanging straight down.
movement: Pull barbell to belly button, elbows high.
end_pos: Return bar down to starting hang.
common_mistakes: Using legs to lift the weight
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press dumbbells straight overhead until arms are locked.
Lower weights back to shoulders under control.
start_pos: Standing or sitting, dumbbells held at ear level.
movement: Press dumbbells vertically over head.
end_pos: Dumbbells overhead close together, then lower to ears.
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width, holding dumbbells at sides.
Raise arms out to sides with slight elbow bend until parallel to floor.
Slowly lower weights to sides.
start_pos: Stand straight, dumbbells at sides.
movement: Raise arms sideways to shoulder level.
end_pos: Hold briefly at parallel, then lower.
common_mistakes: Leading with hands instead of elbows
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes pointed slightly outward.
Push hips back and bend knees, lowering body as if sitting in a chair.
Keep chest up and knees aligned with toes. Lower until thighs are parallel to floor.
Drive through heels to return to standing position.
start_pos: Stand erect, feet shoulder-width, arms forward or at chest.
movement: Lower hips down, bending knees while keeping back straight.
end_pos: Thighs parallel or below, drive upward to start pos.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Lunges
instructions: Stand tall, step forward with one leg.
Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to floor and back knee is just above floor.
Push off front foot to return to standing position. Switch legs.
start_pos: Standing feet together, hands on hips.
movement: Step forward and sink hips down vertically.
end_pos: Both knees at 90 degrees, drive back up.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit on leg extension machine, shins behind rollers.
Extend knees fully to lift weight, squeezing quads at top.
Lower weight slowly to start position.
start_pos: Seated on machine, knees bent at 90 degrees.
movement: Straighten legs upward.
end_pos: Legs straight, pause, then return.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down or sit on leg curl machine, ankles under pads.
Curl legs up toward glutes, squeezing hamstrings.
Slowly extend legs back to start.
start_pos: Positioned on curl machine, legs fully extended.
movement: Pull heels toward butt.
end_pos: Contract fully, then slowly extend.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Calf Raises
instructions: Stand on edge of step on balls of feet.
Lower heels down below step level to stretch calves.
Press up onto toes as high as possible, squeezing calves.
start_pos: Balls of feet on step edge, heels hanging.
movement: Rise high onto balls of feet.
end_pos: Lower heels slowly to deep stretch.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding barbell with underhand grip, shoulder-width.
Keep elbows tucked near waist, curl bar up toward shoulders.
Lower bar slowly to start.
start_pos: Standing straight, barbell held at thighs.
movement: Curl barbell upward using biceps.
end_pos: Bar at chest level, squeeze, then lower.
common_mistakes: Not extending arm fully at bottom
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at sides, palms facing inward (neutral grip).
Curl weights up while keeping palms facing each other.
Lower weights back to sides.
start_pos: Stand straight, dumbbells at sides, palms inward.
movement: Curl dumbbells up, maintaining neutral palms.
end_pos: Dumbbells near shoulders, then lower.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Cable Pushdown
instructions: Face cable machine, grip bar/rope at chest level with elbows tucked.
Push bar/rope down until arms are fully extended.
Slowly return to start, keeping elbows locked at sides.
start_pos: Grip attachment at chest, elbows bent at 90, tucked in.
movement: Push attachment down to thighs.
end_pos: Arms fully straight, lock triceps, then return.
common_mistakes: Letting bar fly up too fast
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Extension
instructions: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lower weight behind head by bending elbows, keeping upper arms still.
Extend elbows to push dumbbell back overhead.
start_pos: Sit, holding dumbbell vertical overhead in both hands.
movement: Lower dumbbell behind neck, bending elbows.
end_pos: Press dumbbell back to high starting position.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Plank
instructions: Place forearms on floor, elbows under shoulders.
Extend legs back, toes on floor, lift hips into straight line.
Contract abs, squeeze glutes, and hold for time.
start_pos: Resting on forearms and toes, body elevated.
movement: Static hold, contracting full body.
end_pos: Lower knees to relax.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat on floor.
Place hands lightly behind head or crossed over chest.
Contract abs to lift shoulders off floor, exhaling.
Slowly lower back down.
start_pos: Lie flat, knees bent at 90, feet flat.
movement: Lift shoulder blades 2-3 inches off floor.
end_pos: Squeeze abs at top, then lower.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Leg Raises
instructions: Lie on your back, legs straight, hands under hips for support.
Slowly raise legs up to 90 degrees.
Lower legs slowly back down until they are just above the floor.
start_pos: Lie flat on back, legs extended straight.
movement: Raise legs vertically without bending knees.
end_pos: Legs vertical, lower them slowly without touching floor.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall, chest out, shoulders back. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping elbows close to your torso, curl the weights up toward shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells under control to the start position.
start_pos: Stand upright with dumbbells held at sides, palms facing front.
movement: Flex elbows to bring dumbbells to shoulders.
end_pos: Bring dumbbells to peak elevation, squeeze bicep, then slowly descend.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Dumbbell Squats
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, hanging at your sides (or hold one at chest level).
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body by bending at hips and knees, keeping chest high.
Push back up to starting position.
start_pos: Stand erect holding dumbbells at sides or shoulders.
movement: Lower hips down into squat depth.
end_pos: Stand back up fully.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest level.
Grip handles and step forward to create tension.
Press handles forward, extending arms fully.
Control handles back to starting position.
start_pos: Hold band handles at chest height, anchor behind you.
movement: Press bands straight forward.
end_pos: Fully extend arms, squeeze chest, return to chest height.
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Rest barbell across upper back muscles (traps).
Unrack bar, step back, set feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower hips until thighs are parallel to ground.
Drive upward through heels to return to start.
start_pos: Barbell supported on upper back, tall chest, feet shoulder width.
movement: Descend by flexing hips and knees.
end_pos: Parallel squat depth, explode back to standing.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of thighs with slight knee bend.
Hinge forward at hips, pushing glutes back while keeping spine flat.
Lower weights along shins until hamstrings stretch deeply.
Contract hamstrings and glutes to return to upright posture.
start_pos: Standing straight holding weights in front of thighs.
movement: Hinge at hips pushing hips backward.
end_pos: Deep hamstring stretch at shin level, pull hips forward to stand.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on bench edge, brace tricep against inner thigh.
Curl dumbbell upward toward shoulder without moving upper arm.
Squeeze bicep at peak and lower under control.
start_pos: Seated, arm extended down with elbow braced against thigh.
movement: Flex elbow to curl weight upward.
end_pos: Peak bicep contraction, lower back down.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Russian Twists
instructions: Sit on floor, lean back slightly at 45 degrees with knees bent.
Interlock hands or hold weight, rotate torso to right side.
Pause briefly, then rotate smoothly to left side.
start_pos: V-sit torso angle, feet hovering or heels lightly touching.
movement: Twist shoulders side to side.
end_pos: Alternating side tap with controlled core tension.
common_mistakes: Twisting arms only instead of shoulders
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on upright bench holding dumbbells at ear level.
Press dumbbells directly overhead until arms lock out.
Lower under control back to ear level.
start_pos: Seated upright, dumbbells at ear height.
movement: Press dumbbells vertically overhead.
end_pos: Arms extended overhead, then lower slowly.
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Tricep Dips
instructions: Place hands on bench or chair behind you, feet extended forward.
Lower hips by bending elbows until upper arms are parallel to floor.
Press through palms to push back up.
start_pos: Hands on bench edge, body suspended, knees/legs extended.
movement: Bend elbows straight back to lower body.
end_pos: Elbows at 90 degrees, press up to straight arms.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Pull-ups
instructions: Grip pull-up bar overhand slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull chest up to bar by driving elbows down toward hips.
Lower body with full control until arms are extended.
start_pos: Dead hang on bar, arms fully extended.
movement: Pull body up until chin clears bar.
end_pos: Chin above bar, lower back down slowly.
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against chest with both palms supporting head.
Stand with feet shoulder-width, squat down until elbows touch inside of knees.
Drive back up standing tall.
start_pos: Standing straight holding dumbbell at chest.
movement: Lower hips deep, knees tracking toes.
end_pos: Deep squat position, explode to standing.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Position upper arms flat against the preacher bench pad.
Grip the bar or dumbbells shoulder-width apart.
Lower weight under control until arms are extended.
Curl the weight up towards shoulders squeezing biceps.
start_pos: Arms resting over preacher pad, holding weight extended.
movement: Flex elbows to curl weight upward.
end_pos: Peak contraction at top, then lower smoothly.
safety_notes: Do not drop weights at bottom extension.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Attach bar to low cable pulley station.
Stand upright holding bar with underhand grip.
Curl bar towards chest keeping elbows pinned to sides.
Lower under constant cable tension.
start_pos: Standing tall, holding cable bar at thighs.
movement: Curl bar upward towards shoulders.
end_pos: Squeeze biceps at top, return slowly.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit back on incline bench set to 45-60 degrees.
Let arms hang fully extended holding dumbbells.
Curl dumbbells up supinating wrists at top.
Lower weights under strict control.
start_pos: Seated on incline bench, arms hanging straight down.
movement: Curl weights upward keeping upper arms back.
end_pos: Full contraction at top, return under stretch.
safety_notes: Maintain shoulder blade contact with bench.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Skull Crushers
instructions: Lie on flat bench holding EZ bar above chest.
Bend elbows lowering weight towards forehead.
Extend elbows pushing weight back over chest.
start_pos: Lying flat, bar held vertically above shoulders.
movement: Hinge at elbows lowering bar toward forehead.
end_pos: Press back to arm extension over chest.
safety_notes: Use secure overhand grip; use spotter if heavy.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench gripping barbell shoulder-width apart.
Lower bar to lower chest keeping elbows tucked.
Press bar straight back up to arm lockout.
start_pos: Lie on bench, bar held shoulder-width above chest.
movement: Lower bar to sternum keeping elbows close.
end_pos: Press bar up locking triceps.
common_mistakes: Grip too narrow causing wrist pain
safety_notes: Keep thumbs wrapped securely around bar.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit facing cable row station with feet on footrests.
Grip handle and pull towards lower abdomen.
Squeeze shoulder blades together at end range.
Extend arms forward smoothly.
start_pos: Seated upright, arms extended holding cable attachment.
movement: Pull handle back squeezing lat muscles.
end_pos: Handle near abdomen, then release under control.
safety_notes: Keep chest proud and spine neutral.
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Sit on bench holding dumbbells at chest level with palms facing in.
Rotate wrists while pressing dumbbells overhead.
At top extension, palms face forward.
Lower and rotate back to starting position.
start_pos: Seated, dumbbells in front of shoulders, palms inward.
movement: Press up while rotating palms outward.
end_pos: Overhead extension with palms facing forward.
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Reverse Fly
instructions: Bend forward at hips keeping flat back posture.
Hold light dumbbells under chest with slight elbow bend.
Raise arms out to sides until elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower weights under control.
start_pos: Hinged forward, arms hanging below chest.
movement: Raise arms laterally squeezing rear delts.
end_pos: Arms parallel to floor, return under control.
safety_notes: Use moderate weight to preserve isolation.
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest upper back against sturdy bench, feet flat on floor.
Position barbell across hip crease.
Drive through heels extending hips toward ceiling.
Squeeze glutes at peak then lower under control.
start_pos: Seated against bench with hips down and bar loaded.
movement: Push hips upward until torso is horizontal.
end_pos: Peak glute contraction at top, return down.
safety_notes: Use barbell pad for hip cushion.
coaching_cues: Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Avoid hyper-extending your lower back at peak extension.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in leg press machine with feet shoulder-width on platform.
Release safety handles and lower platform toward chest.
Press platform back up using quads without locking knees.
start_pos: Seated with legs extended holding machine platform.
movement: Lower platform bending knees to 90 degrees.
end_pos: Press platform back up to starting position.
safety_notes: Keep lumbar spine pressed firmly against backrest.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Wrist Curls
instructions: Rest forearms on bench with palms facing up and wrists hanging off edge.
Hold dumbbells and curl wrists upward.
Lower dumbbells slowly to feel deep forearm stretch.
start_pos: Forearms flat on bench, wrists hanging with dumbbells.
movement: Flex wrists upward squeezing forearm muscles.
end_pos: Lower wrists back down under full stretch.
safety_notes: Use light weight to avoid wrist joint strain.
coaching_cues: Use a full range of motion at your wrist.
Keep your forearm resting securely.
Perform smooth, controlled repetitions.

name: Farmers Walk
instructions: Stand tall holding heavy dumbbells at your sides.
Brace core and walk forward taking smooth steps.
Maintain erect posture and tight grip throughout.
start_pos: Standing upright holding dumbbells at sides.
movement: Walk controlled distance with chest high.
end_pos: Set weights down safely when finished.
safety_notes: Brace abs and keep spine straight.
coaching_cues: Use a full range of motion at your wrist.
Keep your forearm resting securely.
Perform smooth, controlled repetitions.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on padded mat holding ab roller handles.
Roll wheel forward extending arms and body.
Contract abs pulling wheel back to knees.
start_pos: Kneeling, ab wheel directly below shoulders.
movement: Roll wheel forward until body is near floor.
end_pos: Pull back using abdominal strength.
safety_notes: Do not extend farther than abs can support.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand lunge distance in front of bench with rear foot elevated.
Lower hips by bending front knee to 90 degrees.
Drive through front heel to return to top.
start_pos: One leg elevated on bench, standing on front leg.
movement: Lower hips vertically bending front knee.
end_pos: Push back up to upright standing position.
safety_notes: Master bodyweight balance before adding dumbbells.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on side resting on elbow and forearm.
Lift hips until body forms straight diagonal line.
Hold position bracing obliques.
start_pos: Lying on side, elbow stacked under shoulder.
movement: Raise hips off floor holding alignment.
end_pos: Hold position for set duration.
safety_notes: Keep neck in neutral alignment with spine.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.
